invariants.contract: DELETE of a cover image by a user with only delete permission removes the file and its libraryFiles entry, keeps the audio files, answers 200, moves updatedAt and emits item_updated. DELETE of an audio file removes it from disk, libraryFiles and the book's audioFiles; the item stays present and the book duration column is unchanged. Deleting a supplementary ebook leaves the primary ebookFile; deleting the primary ebook clears ebookFile and flags the item missing. Deleting an episode's file removes the episode row, its progress and its playlist entries (renumbering the playlist, emptying and removing it with playlist_removed to its owner only) and keeps the other episodes.
